reviews.review_description: 5th June I got the ok for Victoria gov solar panel.It took SunRun until 30 June to start the installation.30 June 2 installers got to our house at 9am to remove old panels And start installing.They never intended to come back, because they took their scaffolding.To this day they can't they can give me a return date, dispute emails & phone calls.

Sunrun Solar were so easy to deal with.  Karyn in sales was really helpful and explained to me so I understood.  She was not pushy which I appreciated.  The installation was done by professionals and they were very respectful, friendly and did a great jobThanks to Sunrun Solar for an easy transition to solar

The installer grabbed our attention immediately with a prompt response (within a day). The sales rep was knowledgeable, extremely patient (issuing new quotes as our requests evolved), and very responsive. The quoted price was in the middle of the range on Solarquotes for our specs. Organization of rebates, interest free loan, and grid connection were very smooth and handled by the installer. However, the quality of service dropped after we paid the deposit. Three weeks passed before we received a call to book the install, causing us to miss our preferred installation date (in spite of attempts by the original sales rep). The final invoice was incorrect and required a call to rectify. The installer (subcontract) was professional and punctual but undermanned, causing installation to take an extra day. He clearly installed the system with care, and made every effort to conceal the required conduits. He gave us all the information we needed and tested the connectivity before leaving. Final inspection occurred a few days later without incident. The system is up and running and we are thrilled with it!

The team at Sunrun are easy to communicate with and offered great advice for my home installation. I installed Jinko solar panels for a 13.2kw system, paired with a Goodwe inverter.  The installation team needed to reschedule twice and on the day they came, they needed to work overtime to complete the installation; however, they kept me up to date with what was happening and why, which was appreciated.4 / 5 stars only due to some rubbish and debris left behind after the installation, but otherwise no issues. Now awaiting grid connection and looking forward to catching those rays!

After researching the requirements for my property, I was always pleasantly surprised at the sales and quoting process. I did not choose the lowest offer, nor did I choose on service alone. The panels and inverter requirements were sorted, the quotes were presented in the same format across the board however every time this company said they would deliver or send information, they did!! Well done to the Sales & Service team.The installation occurred on the date set given the Melbourne weather was on point (winning!). The installers turned up on time, made swift work of installing the panels and inverter and the job was done within 6 hours. I was impressed with their safety working from heights, there attitude to get it done with no damage to tiles and leaving the site with no mess to my property nor my neighbours. These were contractors who spent 90% of their time on working with Sunrun Solar so new the products well and provided efficient installation given their knowledge.I was advised there would be a 2-3 week wait for the inspection however I was pleasantly surprised that this actually happened less than 48 hours after install. For this to occur, the paperwork was lodged on the same afternoon as the install and as the inspector was in the area, they called to see if we could accommodate, and it was all done in 1 hour. The inspector was aware of the quality of the work, so it was simple for them to sign off accordingly.We are waiting for the electricity wholesaler to authorise the power back to the grid however this may take some time to occur.in summary, I highly recommend Sunrun Solar for their professionalism across sales, quotation, service and genuine reliability that can be hard to find in today's world. Much appreciated and thank you.

Never use this company. They lie to you and say the use full time employees for installs, but they don't. The installer showed up in a van with another companies name on it, wearing another companies shirt and when I asked at the end of the install, confirmed in no uncertain words that they were sub-contractors.These subcontractors damaged my house by drilling a hole in the brick before checking if it would work then they just filled the hole with silicone and shards of brick and didn't mention. It wasn't until the next day that I noticed it and reported to Sunrun who refused to fix it.They also left scratches all over my colorbond roof which the subcontractor did come back and spray over. They also sprayed the silicone hole a vaguely similar colour which apparently for Sunrun is good enough.Absolute rubbish company that will lie to your face to make a sale and take no responsibility for damages afterwards. Avoid them at all costs

I held off on doing a review until we could verify that what they've installed was actually useful. Four months in and it has reduced our energy bill by half, even through winter and all the weather events since it was installed. Definitely recommending Sunrun Solar for not overpromising anything but delivering on their estimates.

Sunrun solar provided me quotes with a variety of different panels and inverters. They explained things to me and what was best for my needs. The installation was great very tidy they put things like their rubbish in a box. Made sure broken roof tiles were replaced or fixed. Sunrun organised the grid connection. They were there from start to finish. Would definitely recommend them for anyone wanting a solar system.

After weeks of research and multiple quotes, we settle with Sunrun Solar for our solar installation. They were not the cheapest but the most honest and transparent company. Some of the companies we had quotes with tried to manipulate the prices after each conversation, whereas Sunrun Solar stayed firm on their price after we provided them with all the information they requested.That honesty and ethical practice was the biggest tick for us to choose them. They have a local office you can visit and look at the products and their system designer was available for the meeting to understand our energy needs.I would highly recommend them over other retailers.For potential customers remember solar systems will stay on your roof for a long time, so invest in a good system through a good retailer that has the best customer interest.

Found installation and sales process with Sunrun Solar to be fantastic. Good priced and very easy to contact. My Sales Agent, Prajwal, did a great job at ensuring I was kept up to date at all stages. He was also very patient as I had a few issues with submitting the request for rebate through Solar Victoria, but helped to guide me through all steps. Overall I found Sunrun Solar very professional, I would recommend.

From the very first contact, Sunrun Solar impressed me with their professionalism.  The consultation process was informative and helpful, and they were patient in answering all my questions.The installation itself was a breeze. The crew arrived on time and were incredibly courteous throughout the day. They worked efficiently, causing minimal disruption, and most importantly, their quality of work is top-notch.I was particularly impressed with how clean and tidy they left the site. They meticulously removed any debris from the installation process, leaving my home looking exactly as they found it, except with a brand new solar system!Overall, I cannot recommend Sunrun Solar highly enough. Their professionalism, quality installation, and attention to detail make them the perfect choice for anyone considering solar power.  I'm thrilled with my new system and look forward to the years of clean energy savings to come!

Sunrun solar was great to deal with from start to finish. I have installed 35kw on my new house and can’t believe how good they are to work with. 100% worked as per my expectation. Workmanship was topnotch.

My friend had a good experience with Sunrun Solar and so he recommended them to me. And I had same wonderful experience dealing with them. Jaryd provided the best quote we had received so far, was always there to quickly respond to any queries and kept updated us about the progress. Their installation team were good too and everything was smooth on installation day. Will definitely recommend.

Sunrun Solar was amazing to deal with. They provided detailed quotes and allowed some of the extra costings that the other retailers could not see while quoting (may be trying to undercut). So we had zero issues during the installation. Canopy for the inverter was allowed during the quoting stage which was installed by the installers.Hands down the best company to deal with for solar and batteries.

If you are looking for a company to install solar system for your home without any issues, Sunrun Solar is your company. No pushy sales tactics, honest service, great workmanship and great products. Don't just compare the price when buying solar system, look at the other things they may have to offer like mounting system, knowledge about products and electrical components.

The solar consultant provide clear and professional opinion on the choice of the solar panel plan.  She followed up the whole process well with prompt response.The installation went well and the people were doing their good well and efficient,

We had our old solar system replaced by Sunrun Solar. They gave us the right advice and installed a new system which is now working so efficiently.Highly recommend Sunrun Solar for their work and service.

Sunrun Solar was recommended to me by SolarQuotes and we had them install a 10.56kW system at our Melbourne home in late March. They were great to deal with, very professional and courteous and they did a good job at a competitive price. We especially want to thank Sachin for his excellent customer service throughout the process and for patiently answering the tons of questions we had for him. Would definitely recommend!

If you value peace of mind, then Sunrun Solar is highly recommended. They'll walk you through the entire process and make sure that you have the right solution. Being a local company with a physical address gives you extra security that you have somewhere to go and someone to talk to if you have any issues.

The team at Sunrun Solar was great to deal with. Timely and responsive communication, they keep you informed throughout the whole process of getting your solar system installed. They ask the right questions, provide honest advice and technical information, and most of all, work with you to find the right solution for your situation. Highly organised and meticulous workmanship throughout the installation. Highly recommended. Would definitely work with them again on future projects.
Great service with an excellent inverter installed. Installer was friendly, efficient & very competent

The sales process was smooth, with clear, detailed quotes and no pressure. Installation was prompt and professional; the team was polite, tidy, and punctual. Customer service went above and beyond, assisting with the grid connection and providing a thorough demonstration of how to use the system.
Very easy to deal with. Sales staff were friendly.Pricing seemed reasonable.Communications were good
We have used sunrun solar for our solar requirement. And I must tell it was a really smooth process throughout.Thank you

Great service and low prices, fast and tidy installation, these guys do everything from selling the right product for your property, installation in the right area and take care of all the paperwork including grid connection and government rebate.

Sales and quoting process was informative and didn’t feel I was pressured to make the purchase. Installers were experienced and didn’t break any tiles. Overall happy with the price and service provided.

Sunrun solar answered all my questions and explained me the difference between few systems I was contemplating.The installation team was very professional. Timeframe for installation was a little more than other companies but I was happy to wait for a good installation.Highly recommend Sunrun Solar to anyone looking for solar. I will contact them in 6 months for battery installation.

My dealings with Ross from the sales team were very positive. He provided a competitive quote in a timely way. Unfortunately the battery that we were quoted on ended up being unsuitable for our property, so we had to change plans at the time of installation.Another employee, gave me an installation date within a couple of weeks of paying the 10% deposit on 25 September 2023. This was meant to be 6 December, which was more than the 5 weeks indicated in the original proposal, Unfortunately I received a call in the afternoon of 5 December advising that installation would be delayed until 18 December 2023.The installers arrived on 18 December 2023 and discovered that the battery that we had been quoted on, was not suitable for our set-up. The team came up with an alternative, that cost more, and was not available until after the Christmas period.The battery was finally installed on 31 January 2024 however the necessary wiring work was not completed until 14 February. The ESV inspector attended on 26 February and has advised that more work needs to be done by the installer in order for our system to be connected to the grid.I am hoping that by mid March this work will be done, but I am still waiting for confirmation.

I contacted Sunrun Solar few months before my new build house to be handed over by the builder. I spoke with Prajwal who patiently took all the details and provided me with various options. I went through all the finer details on my power usage, my appliances, heating and cooling in the house, and the north west direction of my house. Prajwal considered all this information and provided me with the solar panel and the inverter, the size and the type of panel that will suit our requirement. He also mentioned that their installers are in-house, meaning they don't use contractors. This was very important as I have heard stories of contractor installers who do not provide a good installation service. On the installation day, the installation crew turned up (there were at least 6 members). I asked them to double check if the panels were not damaged, as they were in the open space for a few days. They checked and confirmed all were okay and proceeded to install the panels. After installation they provided me with the information on how an inspector will come to check and turn on the inverter. This also happened without much of a delay and I started getting the benefit of the solar panels. It has been 4 or 5 months since I started using the solar, and I have not had to pay my electricity bill yet, thanks to Summer as well.I highly recommend Sun Run Solar and appreciate Prajwal for his exceptional customer service.

Incredibly thankful of Sachin for his excellent customer service. His guidance to help us get the right set up possible within our budget was great. The installation team were top notch too. Courteous, respectful and very helpful.
Tarak from sun solar has gone well and above our expectations and made the whole process very smooth. We knew nothing about it and he explained us very well. Would highly recommend him.

The sales/quoting was definitely a 5 star. Prajwal was very thorough in explaining the system to me and was also very helpful correcting what I might have misunerstood. He explained to me how the Tesla battery is better. He convinced me to go with Tesla for battery and it is really a good decision and I am really glad he convinced me to do so.The installation process is where things can be improved. I paid a deposit of 20 percent on September 21, 2023 a day after I signed up with Prajwal. It was not after over 2 weeks that I heard from the installation man, Harsh. I was getting worried and was starting to think that I got scammed. Harsh reassured me but was not able to give an exact date of installation just a rough estimate. I am not sure exactly of the time frames, but close to the date of the rough estimate of the installation, they informed me that the guy who is suppose to do my solar installation had an accident. He fell of the roof apparently. My installation was postponed without a definite installation date. I was worried that their company might close before my solar is installed. The most frustrating part is they give me non definite installation day, something they are hoping for but then they never call to confirm that it is gonna happen or even if it was not going to happen. I got cranky and unhappy during the waiting time for installation. I feel bad to those I might have been rude on the phone. The installation eventually was completed on the 5th of December, 2 and a half months since I paid the deposit. I paid the rest cash as I did not get the battery interest free loan being offered by Victoria.The installers were polite. They came on the day early. Ahmad appears to be well knowledgeable about what he is doing. I also find that he does not accept sub standards and wants things to be done to the best. They were also quite careful and only broke one roof tile which is really good as I only had 8 spares. They cleaned and tidied the garage really well.Sunrun organised the grid connection, but because it was the Holidays already, Powercor was on holidays too and did not get my solar alteration, whatever that means until 12/02/24. That is when I finally started getting Feed-in Tariffs.The process starting from when I signed up to having FIT took almost 5 months. Inspite of all, I am still happy to give a 5 star review. The guys just needs to communicate with their customers more frequently.Would I recommend Sunrun Solar? Absolutely Yes.
Sunrun Solar is a good proffesional company, polite, on time and reliable
Both sales and quote goodInstallation excellentCustomer service excellent
Sunrun solar hit all the marks of really good service, price & installation.

Sales process was fine.I cannot speak for the quality of the installation itself and I have no issues with the installers.  However, the installation process/customer service was terrible.  Our installation was incomplete and then our job was 'lost'.   This occurred twice through the process and each time we had to join the back of the installation queue to be completed.  Very disappointing and displayed a lack of care.  No responsibility taken or priority given to complete our job.We signed up at the start of Sep 2024 and currently (Jan 2024) awaiting connection to the grid.

We received three recommended suppliers from SolarQuotes but only two initially responded to my requests.  The third company responded after a prompt from my feedback to Finn.Ross from Sunrun Solar was extremely knowledgeable and promptly answered all my questions.  I compared the quotes with a couple of local quotes and Sunrun was the most comprehensive.  Being a bit of a newbie as far as Solar goes, I ran them past my knowledge brother.  We came up with several questions which Ross promptly answered and we made a slight alteration to the Inverter. Another big deciding factor was that Sunrun used their own crew and not sub-contractors for the install.  Having family in the building trade, I preferred to deal with experienced installers.Being in Ballarat I was a bit hesitant to get an installer from Melbourne.  Also being two storey and a difficult install, I sent Ross pictures and stressed that I didn’t want visible conduit from the three different arrays.  To top it off, the inverter would be in the garage opposite the fuse box through a double brick cavity wall.  He advised that it wouldn’t be an issue.  I’d seen a few atrocious looking installs and didn’t want to go there.We booked the install date and Corey and the crew turned up right on time (even called to advise when they were in transit). They got straight into it and commenced the install, also happily answered all my questions.   At all times they were polite, knowledgeable and respectful.  Considering the difficulty of the install, they only cracked two tiles (I had 15 ready).  At the end of the day they cleaned up everything and took all the rubbish with them.  No dirt or dust left anywhere.  Corey returned a couple of days later to connect the inverter.  I’m currently waiting to get the signoff from Energy Vic.Big shout out to Ross, Corey and the crew, they are a credit to Sunrun Solar and I have no hesitation in recommending them for your solar install.

Sales process was good. Paul took time to go through the various options and also do some detailed analysis of the potential shading from trees on my fenceline. He has happy to go through some clarifications and tweaks. Price wasn't the lowest, however was competitive. However, after the sale (pre and post install), I did ask about buying Solar Analytics through Sunrun but other than the initial "will get back to you", I've heard nothing so have signed up directly.Installation was average. It seemed the installers did not review the contract or design thoroughly before the day. It was agreed in the contract that our TV antenna would be moved, but the installers wanted to leave it and move the north array panels instead, which would have potential shading issues. The accredited installer arrived later and only stayed for a bit, and wanted to charge me $100 extra to move the antenna. Ultimately, they moved it but not to the location required (they placed it right next to the panels where bird droppings are a problem - I had to pay someone else to move it later) and also found that the tile under the antenna was smashed.The installers also wanted to change my west-facing array to a different location as they claimed the original design was too close to the evaporative cooler unit. So they moved it to a location that isn't ideal (due to potential shading). Upon completion, it looked to me that the array could've fit easily in the original location and seems like they just chose the path of least resistance. I'm not sure that they grinded the roof tiles either - I was told that it is normal and this is the way they do all their installs. Plus quick a few marks were left on the panels from handling.Installers should really not be making changes on the fly as there are good reasons why designs are done a certain way. And claiming that there would be no shading issues whilst standing on the roof at noon in the middle of summer doesn't cut it. Any changes should be: (1) consulted with the designer; and (2) agreed upfront with the customer. A few times during the install, I had to ask what was going on otherwise I would not have known changes were being made nor had the opportunity to reverse them.Lastly, the installer had trouble with the WiFi on my Goodwe inverter as he had not worked with one before (?). I found out later that he had connected to the neighbour's Goodwe inverter and configured that so it would connect via my WiFi.Post install was great. Inspection was done in about 1.5 weeks, and grid connection in about 3 weeks. System has been running well so far, but we'll have to see later in the year when the sun is lower in terms of the effect the changes that were made have on the system. I had a few questions about the inverter noise which was dealt with by Jit. No real documentation other than the invoice and certificates.

Paul was outstanding with gathering all the information before installation took place.Unfortunately still waiting on inspection of system before it can be turned on which was nearly 2 weeks ago. Will contact them tomorrow to chase up .
Rahul was extremely helpful in designing and organising the installation of our 10kw system. From beginning to end was exactly how he said it would be.Thanks Rahul
The whole process right from getting the quote to completing the installation was very smooth, well explained and completed much quicker than expected.

Sachin and team are professionals who not only know how to get the job done but also provide great customer service in every aspect. I'd definitely recommend Sunrun as they not only have quality workmanship but also the right people working for them.

Customer service was great! They were patient when I asked a tons of questions on the solar systems, and also on the difference between various products that they carry.Installation were professional, smooth, and quick. Installer were very professional during the installation, and were helpful in answering any doubts and questions I have.Inspection arrangement and connection to grid were quicker than average too.

Great communication the whole time. Rahul was happy to answer my many many questions. Happy with system performance so far. Hard to know true impact on energy bills but from what I’ve seen so far, should be significant.

Extremely happy with my solar install by Sunrun Solar.Rahul, my sales guy, was extremely helpful and patient with me as I worked through all of my quotes comparing install to install. Rahul was able to break down all the solar stuff in a way that even I could understand. No hard sell, just good info and a friendly chat.Installation day went down without a hitch. The crew showed up on time and clearly knew their stuff. Worked as a production line and installed the system in no time.Grid connection was prompt and worked through the system faster than I thought it would.

Sales person was very good to work with. Offered a number of options and didn’t try a bluff his way through the process. He was very honest and corrected some of my incorrect assumptions about the system we were considering.Installers were very punctual, polite and tidy. There were some minor things with the install that with hindsight could have been done differently but they were only minor cosmetic issues and not technical issues. All wiring and final connections were completed professionally.They withheld getting final payment until the job was fully completed as there was a wait for a week for specialist plugs to add panels to my existing system.Organised electrical inspection for connection to the grid.
Even after 4 years SunRun Solar was happy to come and promptly fix a communication issueThank you so much!
Sunrun did a great job through the entire process, right from the start in making changes to optimise the design, through to quality of the install

I found Sunrun to be easy to communicate with and prompt with replies to any questions. Their pricing was competitive and the products they offered were high quality. Organising installation was seamless and the installation was completed to my satisfaction. I am currently waiting on the system to be inspected, passed an turned on and then will be able to observe the system outputs and also use the phone app to monitor use. So at this stage I am quite happy with the company.
Totally happy with the process from start to finish, installers on time, competent and polite, sadly very rare. Neat installation.

I recently reached out to Sunrun Solar for my solar needs and I received a call from Rahul who helped me understand the whole process end to end and also helped me to choose the best products for my needs and budget. He was not pushy like other sales people, he provided me with all the info and scheduled a followup after checking with me and tried to get me a best deal. He was even open with the installation timelines and was not making any false promises. I signed the deal and the installation team came on the scheduled day on time and completed their installation within a day and they were perfect and cleaned up as well after they were done. They even completed the paperwork quickly so that I get the savings for the extra power my system generates and feeds the grid. They sent me all the manuals and other information I need. I would definitely recommend them purely based on how professional and thorough they are with their work.
Straightforward process and very helpful in answering all questions. Installation was quick and tidy.

Got 12 solar panels and 2 batteries installed. Everything went very smoothly from initial quotes to final installation. Was all done on time, as discussed. Most important step is the first one: discussing your needs, based on your household size, your expected needs etc. Can't only recomment Sunrun Solar. Keep up the great job guys!
We have had a really great experience with Sunrun Solar.The entire process went really well from start to finish.Great team and great work.  Highly recommended.

Sales process went well with the account manager demonstrating over zoom how the system would be configured.Installation was delayed a few weeks due to installer illness.Lead installer was punctual, tidy and pleasant.Communication from Sunrun Solar after installation was a little slow, but connection to grid happened quickly once that was sorted.

The Sunrun solar team are great. Rahul in sales was very helpful and and descriptive on the system I was getting. Any question I had was very responsive straight away with answers.The installers were fantastic. Very professional and clean. Would recommend all the team to anyone as all you guys a great and professional.Thnx again
See above, no problems at all. Installation electricians were happy to answer our questions. No mess.

I have used one of your 3 quotes to put solar on my home.  I rate Sun Run Solar very highly.  They delivered a quality panel and inverter. The installation was very good.  Price of system was fair and customer service was great.I highly recommend Sun run solarGreat job thanksChris W

I recently had the pleasure of working with Sunrun Solar to have solar panels installed on my home, and I have to say that the entire experience was fantastic. From the initial quote to the final installation, the team at Sunrun Solar was professional, knowledgeable, and easy to work with.When I first spoke to Tarak about the project, I was struck by how polite and genuine he was. It was clear that he had a deep knowledge of solar energy, and he took the time to explain the process to me in detail. I was so impressed with him that I didn't feel the need to shop around for other quotes.Once I had finalised the deal, all the documents were sent to me by email, which made everything very easy for me. We are very happy with our solar system. We now generate our own electricity during the day and export excess capacity to the grid resulting in lower energy bills for our home.Going into Summer with solar is awesome as we could switch on our cooling system to combat heat without worrying for the electricity bills :)Dealing with Jaryd Coghill & his team at Sunrun Solar has been a pleasant experience. He even checked on how things are going with our solar months after installation. Rahul was informative all the way through, installers were quick, clean and were very confident in their task.
Thanks to the Sunrun team / Rahul for a great price and quick install.
Sunrun Solar were incredibly easy to deal with and made the process smooth and simple. They were great in following up on communications and kept me notified on all stages of the process.

The quoting process was somewhat complicated but doable. It was a good effort for a good outcome.The installation team was quick and everything happened as predicted. So no unpleasant surprises. Everything seem to have fallen into place.The team completed the installation and left surprisingly quickly.After the installation the customer service organised connecting to the grid and that was that! Ready to start reaping the great benefits.So far it has been the best decision ever as I'm getting credits on energy bills which is something extremes unique these days.

From the initial quote request, right through to the final sign off I had nothing but a great experience with Sun Run Solar!Jaryd and the team provided different options to choose from as well as price ranges on different models and answered all the questions I had in a prompt and professional manner.Installation was a breeze, the install team arrived on time, very friendly, professional and informative and ensured the site was clean following the works.The final inspection was undertaken 2 days later, which was amazing as I was expecting up to 28 days based on reviews I had seen elsewhere!Sun Run also arranged the connection with my energy team following the install and all I had to do was reply to an email confirming it was installed! I am now able to enjoy the savings that my new panels will provide given the increasing electricity costs!

Paul was very knowledgeable and explained everything thoroughly. He was friendly and returned my calls promptly. The installers were friendly, on time and left the premises in a clean and tidy manner. The only downside was the gutter was damaged lifting the panels onto the roof. The colour has been removed and I will have to organise with a painter to repair them. Talking to someone on the phone who I can understand is frustrating. I needed assistance setting up my app and it took forever as I had to keep asking them to repeat what they said. You can’t have someone trying to help you when you don’t understand them!

The experience I had with this company was unpleasant and not as smooth as it should have been.I contacted Solar Quotes to put me in touch with a couple installers in my area. I was contacted by two of the three my contact information was sent to.  The first to contact me didn’t really sell me on their service and were very general in how they answered my technical questions.The second to contact me was Sunrun Solar. Their sales guy was exceptional and accommodating. Credit where it is due. He was able to answer all my questions and didn’t shy away from nuanced technical answers and did not treat me poorly when I needed something explained. Great service from him.For example, the first mob used terms like “battery ready” and didn’t go further than that in discussing what future options could look like. Just that “yeah you can add a battery”. The real answer more nuanced.  Sunrun’s sales explained the differences in system requirements and battery types depending on AC or DC batteries. I.e. if there was a preference for a specific battery upfront, then the system design could be flexible and the choices of battery would be greater. If the system was built with the intent of a future battery set up, then depending on how the initial system was chosen (i.e. if price was a factor) then future battery choices may be limited in the type of battery that could be connected later. This type of answer was always explained exceptionally clearly and taking my level of technical understanding into consideration. I had many of these questions and each was answered with an exceptional level of clarity. I have no doubt their salesperson would be able to tailor their level of detail across a wide range of clients.  That was the best part of the process.After discussing and resolving many of my concerns with the salesperson, I signed with Sunrun Solar. Everything leading up to the day of install went smoothly and as expected.On the day of the install is when things started going poorly.·       Safety rails were installed in such a way that they scratched paint on my colorbond roof.·       Holes were drilled in my brick wall for cable runs where the inverter was to be installed without determining first of there would be any challenges in doing so. Spoiler alert, the cable runs could not be internal as they for some reason couldn’t fit them through the space. The paint was gouged down to the bare metal.·       Dents were made in multiple places on the roof. These remain and wont be resolved.·       Before shots were not taken of the roof for my records prior to beginning works as per request that was documented on my signed quote.During the day the main electrician on the job seemed flustered and when asked how things were going said “everything that could go wrong has gone wrong”. In further clarifying what this meant, he advised that things were taking longer than expected, and gave the issue with being unable to run cables internally through the wall to the inverter as an example of what added time to the install.  I decided not to worry too much at this point as I took the view that these guys are professionals and know what they’re doing.As the day progressed, the main electrician told me it was likely the install wouldn’t be finished that day. Ok no problem. Clearly would be scheduled to be done soon afterwards.The follow up to finish the job was scheduled for the following week in the morning. At lunch time on the day when I hadn’t heard form Sun Run, I contacted them to find out what was happening. They followed up with the electricians who were at another job, got back to me and let me know they would be there later that day.When the electrician arrived, he and his boys got up on the roof, Installed the panels and finalised the wiring.During the visit, the main electrician determined that they were missing a piece of equipment they had thought they had left in my garage and turned out they couldn’t finish the job. A one day install turned into a +3 week saga.In-between this time I noticed from a normal viewing position in my back yard that there were scratches and dents on my roof. No, it’s not, as evidenced by the fact the roof was able to be installed without damage and many solar installs which are done without damage to the roof. The first red flag should have been when there were no gutter guards for the ladders in sight for the entire day.While the owner acknowledged the damage he was looking for me to suggest a solution to him. Really? I told them to come back to me with a proposal.In the end, Sun run offered to spray the damaged sections with a colour matched repair paint. Initially I was open to this, however after some research on the product, I learned that it was not meant for solving the type of deep paint damage that was present on my roof. The manufacturer of the roof material recommends a replacement of sections with damage exceeding small surface scratches, especially where the damage is down to the bare metal.After spotting additional damage and screws replaced without the crush washers on another section of the roof, I advised Sun Run that it was unacceptable, and I asked for a replacement of the damaged sections of the steel as the warranty on those sections was now void.
